title: Bank of Baroda SO Online Form 2026
vacancyDetails: Specialist Officer posts in Bank of Baroda under latest SO recruitment 2026
qualification: Graduation / Post Graduation / Professional qualification as per SO stream (IT, Credit, HR, Marketing, Law etc.)
ageLimit: As per Bank of Baroda SO advertisement (category-wise relaxations)
applicationFee: As per BOB online fee rules
selectionProcess: Online Examination → Interview / GD (as applicable) → Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate, photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.bankofbaroda.bank.in
2. Open Career → Current Opportunities
3. Open Specialist Officer recruitment apply link
4. Register, fill form, upload documents, pay fee
5. Submit and print application
shortDescription: Bank of Baroda SO Online Form 2026. Apply through bankofbaroda.bank.in careers.
content:
Bank of Baroda has released the online application for Specialist Officers (SO) 2026.

Stream-wise eligibility, vacancies and pay scale are given in the official notification. Apply only through the bank’s careers portal within the last date.
